source_policy: Web sources and commercial registers checked independently; source dates and search limitations retained. No confirmation of buying intent or website budget.
task: Find independently operating customer-facing Czech brands with real outside clients and concrete website opportunity. Exclude corporate group captive and project-only property SPV.

priority.commercial_operation: Business directory gives matching website, business contact, recent public customer reviews from 2023-24; official registry shows sole-trader identity and active joinery; first-party site describes working custom furniture workshop and services to external clients.
priority.standalone_brand: Sole-trader public brand; no corporate shareholder/parent applicable. Caution: an additional Martin Kozák IČO is registered at identical address; verify which contracting person holds current project proposals before outreach.
priority.observed_issue: Website homepage visibly contains unrelated 'AGRA Podještědí' agricultural-company heading and assertion of farming 900 hectares, while offering kitchen/furniture services. This is a specific editorial/credibility defect; do not infer a formal technical failure or ownership link from copied content.

priority.status: RESEARCH — EXISTING SITE / TARGETED RENOVATION ONLY

Recheck website visibly in desktop/mobile browser
Confirm interest and budget before proposing changes

Search exact IČO and brand again for any first-party domain
Validate whether a separate branded site would add value beyond already-active Notino reservations
